snippet.description:
Starting your UPSC journey can be confusing.

What should you study? How should you prepare? Should you join a coaching program or prepare on your own? How important are teachers, guidance, discipline, answer writing, revision and mentorship? How do you choose the right approach for your UPSC preparation?

In this special conversation, Nikhil Sheth, Santosh Kumar and Karandeep Singh — Directors at LevelUp IAS — discuss the questions that every UPSC aspirant should think about before and during their preparation.

Whether you are starting UPSC preparation from scratch, preparing alongside college, working a full-time job, planning your first attempt, or already somewhere in your UPSC journey, this conversation will help you understand what really matters.

📚 Explore LevelUp IAS GS Foundation 2028

GS Foundation 2028 Course: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-gs-foundation-course/

In this video, we discuss:
- How to start UPSC preparation the right way
- What every UPSC beginner should understand before starting
- How to choose the right direction for UPSC preparation
- What makes a good UPSC preparation system
- The importance of teachers, guidance and mentorship
- Why discipline and consistency matter in UPSC
- How to deal with doubts during preparation
- How to evaluate your UPSC preparation strategy
- What college students should keep in mind while preparing for UPSC
- How working professionals can approach UPSC preparation
- What to look for before choosing your preparation ecosystem
- Common mistakes UPSC beginners should avoid
- How to build a strong foundation for UPSC CSE
- What it really takes to prepare for both UPSC Prelims and Mains

The UPSC Civil Services Examination requires preparation across multiple stages and competencies, making it important to understand the examination and build a structured approach rather than simply collecting study material.

🎓 About the Speakers

Nikhil Sheth
UPSC History Faculty | Director, LevelUp IAS

Santosh Kumar
S&T, Environment & Current Affairs Faculty | Director, LevelUp IAS

Karandeep Singh
Anthropology Faculty | Director, LevelUp IAS

LevelUp IAS is a UPSC Civil Services Examination preparation platform focused on helping aspirants build conceptual clarity, exam-oriented preparation and a structured approach towards UPSC Prelims, Mains and the complete Civil Services journey.
